headline: Polymarket halts trading after hackers breach third-party service
summary: Polymarket temporarily halted trading after hackers compromised a third-party provider to drain funds from user accounts using cryptocurrency-draining JavaScript. The company says trading has since resumed and that affected traders will be made whole. Roughly $2.5 million in stolen assets has been traced to a suspected attacker wallet.
